summary: One of London's most sought-after facialists, Sarah Chapman's Chelsea Skinesis clinic has become a mecca for skin-savvy celebrities, editors and skin obsessives - and, with its eponymous range, you can share in the miraculous results from home. Ideal for those with stressed-out skin, the Ultra Recovery Booster is here to provide soothing relief.
how_to_use: Apply 1-2 pumps to clean skin, morning and evening before moisturiser.
description:
Overdone it with your acids or retinol? Is your skin feeling tight, dry and irritated? Then the silky-soft Ultra Recovery Booster is just what the doctor ordered. 
 Providing immediate relief and aiding the skin's resilience, this powerful emollient is infused with probiotics, essential fatty acids and a powerful hexapeptide. With omega rich sea buckthorn, inca and borage oils as well as the pre-probiotic complex ecoskin, this soothing super serum works to boost skin's strength, add much needed hydration and maintain the integrity of the moisture barrier. With anti-inflammatory properties too, it treats and comforts sensitised skin while helping to reinforce its natural defences. What's more, it works great as a cushion between your skin and your actives by preventing any sensitivity, flakiness or tightness.
